findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Tracing uses AlwaysOnSampler, exporting 100% of traces regardless of environment
findings.recommendation: Consider a ratio-based sampler (e.g. TraceIdRatioBasedSampler) for production traffic once volume grows, to reduce exporter/collector overhead while keeping full sampling in dev.
